name: Lost Aisles
desc:
Stranded outside an abandoned mall after a car crash in the midst of an apocalypse, you and your friends must survive the oncoming nights until the government gets the situation under control.

◇ Scavenge supplies
◇ Craft weapons and makeshift barricades
◇ Build a base
◇ Survive the nights
◇ Wait for rescue

[NOTE]: We are actively working on adding more features & patching bugs! Everything is bound to change.

Please report bugs in our discord server!
